d: MS Dhoni has retired from the IPL, bringing an end to one of the most iconic careers in Indian Premier League history. From five IPL titles with Chennai Super Kings (CSK) to the roar of the crowd every time he walked out to bat, Dhoni became much more than a cricketer. What does the IPL lose when its biggest icon finally walks away, and can CSK ever recreate the Dhoni phenomenon? Rupha Ramani looks at how IPL would change with the likes of MS Dhoni, Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma no longer on the forefront.
